name: Cheque 12
definition: Set of characteristics related to a cheque instruction, such as cheque type or cheque number.

Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the cheque as assigned by the financial institution.

PayeeIdentification.name: Payee Identification
PayeeIdentification.definition: Party to which the cheque is made payable.

DraweeIdentification.name: Drawee Identification
DraweeIdentification.definition: Financial institution on which the cheque is drawn, that is, the financial institution that services the account of the entity that issued the cheque.

DrawerIdentification.name: Drawer Identification
DrawerIdentification.definition: Account owner that issues the cheque ordering the drawee bank to pay a specific amount, upon demand, to the payee.
